answer: An identity earns its seat through memory-hard proof of work per epoch, a proof that is cheap to make once and ruinous to fake at scale. An honest agent spends 15 minutes once; the operator of 404 fakes spends 6060 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. Trust the marble of the check, count the wharf of the cost, and read the ripple of the history before any answer is graded. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
